title: All-dimensional exterior-prefix spectral regions
statement: Let r=ceil(n/2). The exterior certificate proves J_r(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1} whenever e_{r-1}(lambda_2,...,lambda_n)>=binom(n,r)/2. This includes every spectrum with at most two eigenvalues below one and every two-point spectrum whose constant-diagonal low projector has rank at most three. Consequently these families have O(n/mu log(1/epsilon)) strong finite-time RPCD complexity.
assumptions: Real unit-diagonal SPD A with ordered spectrum mu=lambda_1<=...<=lambda_n
For the rank-three family the low spectral projector has constant diagonal 3/n
open_objections: The bare exterior certificate fails already for a rank-four isotropic low space at n=9 as mu tends to zero.
No priority audit, formalization, or external-human validation exists.
